checks.label: Synthetic fixture: export.editable_reopen
checks.method: For FreeCAD, independently reopen/recompute the trusted-exported native document in isolation and compare its solid, dimensions, holes, bounds within linearMm (0.01 mm), relative volume within stepRelativeVolume (0.00001), and geometric symmetric difference <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3) against checked STEP. Deliver source and describe actual native history. For build123d, regenerate from delivered editable source in a separate isolated generator without verifier authority, stop that generator and seal its STEP, then compare in a fresh trusted verifier using the same measurements. Any Python regeneration for either engine follows this separation; the verifier never executes candidate Python. If the required reopen/regeneration cannot run, return not_evaluated and block acceptance.

checks.label: Synthetic fixture: export.step_reopen
checks.method: Reopen the actual registered STEP export bytes in a fresh trusted verifier and compare with the sealed checked candidate: valid single solid, frame/bounds, required dimensions and holes. Require absolute volume difference divided by positive checked-candidate volume <= stepRelativeVolume (0.00001); use geometric symmetric-difference volume <= differenceVolumeMm3 (0.01 mm3) to detect equal-volume substitutions. Export STEP byte identity must match the sealed geometry hash; if an exporter changes bytes, reseal and revalidate as new evidence before acceptance. Record export hash and independent measurements; verify downloaded-byte identity at delivery.

checks.label: Synthetic fixture: export.stl_reopen
checks.method: Reopen the actual trusted-exported STL bytes independently, with manifest units explicitly mm. Require finite vertices, a closed consistently oriented watertight connected mesh, positive enclosed volume and agreement with checked candidate bounds/dimensions and hole layout within linearMm (0.01 mm). Compare absolute enclosed-volume difference divided by checked-candidate volume <= stlRelativeVolume (0.001). Inspect full-height bore openings and feature bounds on the mesh, not the generator report. Bind the registered STL byte hash and verify the downloaded bytes against it; inability to measure a required property is not_evaluated.

checks.label: Synthetic fixture: holes.layout

checks.label: Synthetic fixture: margin.end_material
checks.method: Measure the shortest material distances between the outer bore boundaries and their corresponding X-min/X-max plate end faces on independently reopened geometry; report both closest-point pairs and their minimum. The centered formula (L-20-6)/2 is a fixture expectation only and must not replace geometric distance measurement.
